# TPC-DS Q20 — Catalog Sales Item Analysis

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpcds
```

> [TPC-DS](../../tpc-ds.md) benchmark · [all TPC-DS queries](index.md)

Reports catalog sales by item category

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
SELECT i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_category, i_class, i_current_price, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) AS itemrevenue, SUM(cs_ext_sales_price) * 100 / SUM(SUM(cs_ext_sales_price)) OVER (PARTITION BY i_class) AS revenueratio FROM catalog_sales, item, date_dim WHERE cs_item_sk = i_item_sk AND i_category IN ('Jewelry', 'Sports', 'Books') AND cs_sold_date_sk = d_date_sk AND d_date BETWEEN CAST('2001-01-12' AS DATE) AND (CAST('2001-01-12' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '30 DAY') GROUP BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, i_category, i_class, i_current_price ORDER BY i_category, i_class, i_item_id, i_item_desc, revenueratio LIMIT 100
```
